content.title: Los Angeles Dodgers vs Colorado Rockies Live Stream: How to Watch MLB
content.text: Dodgers look to push winning streak to five games as road trip continues against the slumping Rockies After a chilly road win last night, the Los Angeles Dodgers continue on their six-game road trip on Saturday night as they take on the Colorado Rockies inside Coors Field for the second game of their three-game weekend series between the National League West Division foes. The Rockies started the season 6-6, but since then are 1-7, having been swept by the Padres and failing to keep runs off the board, conceding five or more runs six times during that span. The Dodgers will start right-hander Emmet Sheehan (2-0, 6.60 ERA) while the Rockies will counter with righty Ryan Feltner (1-1, 7.30 ERA) in search of his first win against L.A. since 2022. How to Watch Los Angeles Dodgers vs Colorado Rockies: Date: April 18, 2026 Time: 8:00 p.m. ET TV Channel: MLB.TV – Los Angeles Dodgers Location: Coors Field Live Stream the Los Angeles Dodgers vs Colorado Rockies game on Fubo: Start watching now! Dodgers center fielder Andy Pages leads Major League Baseball in batting average at .412 this season, having collected 22 hits in 14 games in April, including six multi-hit games in that span. Pages, in his third season in the Majors, is on pace to shatter his career highs in hits, stolen bases, and RBIs after a breakout season in 2025, where he hit .272, helping Los Angeles claim their second consecutive World Series title. With 10 hits in his last 11 games, Rockies catcher Hunter Goodman leads the team, hitting .258 this season, having tallied three home runs in his last three games. Goodman, in his fourth season in Colorado, comes into this season off his first-ever All-Star selection in 2025 and was also awarded the Silver Slugger Award as the National League’s best hitting catcher last season.
